one_time_migration_receipt.rescan_trigger: later same-role config revision or newer same-provider public evidence that contradicts accepted behavior

run_findings.spicedb: ZedToken is a durable authorization-state revision/read fence; storing it with protected content gives a stronger causal content-epoch binding, but the checked evidence does not prove an external effect server atomically consumes the prior auth revision.
run_findings.authzed_materialize: Permission data, stream cursor and revision should be durably committed together; snapshot-to-watch handoff resumes from stored revision to avoid gaps. This is recovery provenance, not effect authorization.
run_findings.kubernetes: Current request authorization can be composed with resourceVersion/UID state preconditions inside the effect-serving API path.
run_findings.gitlab: Approval can be head-SHA preconditioned and merge-train admission can also be head-SHA preconditioned, yielding a fail-closed same-content approval/effect chain when both use the same evolving content identity.
run_findings.github_connected: Connected review exposes commit_id and sync merge exposes expected_head_sha; connected file update requires blob SHA. Public provider REST versioning is newer than the connector-mapped legacy default for these wrappers.
run_findings.stripe_connected: Public Stripe exposes idempotent retry semantics, but generic connected stripe_api_write schema did not expose a caller-controlled Idempotency-Key field; do not assume provider retry identity is directly orchestratable from this surface.
run_findings.negative_rule: Model/policy/decision IDs, prior allow results, approvals, state CAS tokens and idempotency keys are orthogonal evidence classes and must not be promoted beyond their documented provider semantics.
run_findings.true_external_auth_revision_gate: not observed in fresh config-revision-7 evidence
